name: Dranzer V
description: Dranzer V: a Balance phoenix with two unique abilities and one Special.

ability.name: Volcano Drive
ability.description: Each consecutive successful Attack increases Attack damage by 7%. Maximum 3 stacks (21%). Using Defense or Stamina resets the stacks.

special_move.name: Volcanic Eruption
special_move.description: Base damage: 135 + 60% ATK. Gains 10% bonus damage for each Volcano Drive stack. Removes the opponent's strongest removable DEF buff. Cooldown: 4 rounds.

abilities.name: Volcano Drive
abilities.description: Each consecutive successful Attack increases Attack damage by 7%. Maximum 3 stacks (21%). Using Defense or Stamina resets the stacks.

abilities.name: Phoenix Guard
abilities.description: Activates when HP drops below 45%. Gains 25% DEF. Gains 10% damage reduction. Effects last 2 rounds. Once per battle.
